meta.description: Find vinyl pressings, keep a wishlist and track your collection.

common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

home.title: Find the exact pressing.
home.lead: Search by track, pick the artist and album, then compare pressings by country, year and label. Keep a wishlist and a collection of your own.
home.step1Text: No need to remember the album. Type a song and see who pressed it on vinyl.
home.step2Text: Filter by country, year and label to find the one on your shelf, or the one you want.
home.step3Text: A wishlist and a collection, with your own notes and condition grading.
